info.title: Kenya Land Valuation API
info.description: Backend API for the Kenya land valuation app.  Provides price-per-acre predictions, market insights, and model explainability for Kenyan land parcels.

get.description:
Liveness + readiness probe.

Returns ``status: ok`` when all artifacts are loaded **and** the model
registry successfully loaded the ensemble (so ``/api/v1/predict`` is
usable).  ``degraded`` covers two cases:

1. The ``ArtifactRegistry`` (B0) found a missing top-level file
   (``xgb_model.json``, ``preprocessing.json``, …).
2. The ``ModelRegistry`` (this phase) raised ``ModelLoadError`` —
   typically because ``serving_manifest.json`` or one of the model
   files it lists is missing, or because the feature pipeline's
   ``scoring_params.json`` / ``reference_data.json`` /
   ``feature_manifest.json`` are absent.

In both cases the app still starts so ``/docs`` and the test suite
work without the large model files.

Return lightweight artifact metadata.

When artifacts are not loaded (degraded mode) all fields are ``null``.

post.description:
Predict the price per acre of a Kenyan land parcel.

Returns 503 ``MODEL_NOT_LOADED`` when the ensemble is not loaded
(degraded mode — copy the artefacts into ``ARTIFACTS_DIR`` and restart).
The live explanation and comparables blocks are added when their
respective services are available; they degrade to ``null`` / ``[]``
independently (e.g. when ``listings_scored.parquet`` is missing the
prediction still returns, just without comparables).

get.description:
One row per county, sorted by listing count descending (Cell 9.5).

**This is the single source of truth for medians / IQR** — the per-listing
endpoint does NOT recompute them, to avoid two sources of truth drifting apart.

Simplified GeoJSON of Kenya's 47 county boundaries for the choropleth.

Returns the raw GeoJSON (cached at startup).  The GeoJSON is simplified
via Douglas-Peucker (tolerance reported in the manifest) to keep the
file light for page-load rendering.

schema.title: Response County Boundaries Api V1 Counties Boundaries Get

get.description:
Per-county listing counts from ``listings_scored.parquet`` — for the
scatter-plot tab's county picker + the "N listings" label.

This does NOT return medians (those come from /counties/summary).  It
only reports how many listings each county has in the per-listing
endpoint's backing frame, so the frontend can warn when a county's
coverage is thin.

Per-listing scatter-plot data for one county.

Returns ``price_per_acre_ksh``, ``dist_to_nairobi_km`` (recomputed from
lat/lon via B1's haversine), ``size_acres``, and ``verdict`` for each
listing in the county.  Backed by ``listings_scored.parquet`` (Cell 9.6)
— the only export that carries ``listed_price_per_acre_ksh`` +
``size_acres`` together.  The prediction parquets (oof/test) lack
``size_acres`` and only carry ``y_true`` (log scale), not the asking
price per acre.

**Medians / IQR for the ranked list and deep-dive cards come from
/counties/summary (county_summary.csv) — this endpoint does NOT
recompute them.**
CV + test metrics with bootstrap CIs, ensemble weights, interval coverage.
Phase 3 ranked feature table (Cell 3.8, written by Cell 9.3).
Global mean-|SHAP| + native & permutation importance + feature labels.

Per-listing actual vs. predicted values for both splits.

Returns both the development-set out-of-fold predictions and the test-set
predictions in one payload.  Each row carries the identifier columns
(listing_url, listing_no, county, prop_type, etc.) so the frontend can
link a scatter point back to its listing.

parameters.name: sample

schema.description: If set, return a deterministic random sample of this many rows from each split (oof + test) rather than every row.  Useful for scatter plots where the full row count would be wasteful.  The sample is deterministic (seed=42) so the same request always returns the same rows.
schema.title: Sample

parameters.description: If set, return a deterministic random sample of this many rows from each split (oof + test) rather than every row.  Useful for scatter plots where the full row count would be wasteful.  The sample is deterministic (seed=42) so the same request always returns the same rows.

get.description:
OOF error broken down by listing-count support bands.

Returns ``error_by_support.csv`` (Cell 9.9) — two groups of bands:
- ``county_listings``: error by the number of listings in the county
  (<10 / 10-19 / 20-49 / 50+)
- ``nearby_within_50km``: error by the number of listings within 50km
  (<5 / 5-9 / 10-19 / 20-49 / 50+)
Typeahead search over the places gazetteer.
Named POIs within radius_km of a coordinate.

parameters.name: data_quality_flag

schema.description: true = only flagged rows (outside the dev 1st-99th percentile); false = only clean rows; absent = both.
schema.title: Data Quality Flag

parameters.description: true = only flagged rows (outside the dev 1st-99th percentile); false = only clean rows; absent = both.

parameters.name: near_amenity

schema.description: Filter to listings within radius_km of an amenity — one of 'school', 'hospital', 'tarmac_road'.  Recomputes the per-listing distance from stored lat/lon via B1's BallTrees (raw distances did not survive into listings_scored.parquet).
schema.title: Near Amenity

parameters.description: Filter to listings within radius_km of an amenity — one of 'school', 'hospital', 'tarmac_road'.  Recomputes the per-listing distance from stored lat/lon via B1's BallTrees (raw distances did not survive into listings_scored.parquet).

parameters.name: radius_km

schema.description: Radius (km) for the near_amenity filter — one of 1, 3, 5.
schema.title: Radius Km

parameters.description: Radius (km) for the near_amenity filter — one of 1, 3, 5.

parameters.name: sort

schema.description: Sort key: 'listed_over_predicted' (default, ascending — most underpriced first), 'listed_price_per_acre_ksh', 'predicted_price_per_acre_ksh', 'size_acres'.
schema.title: Sort

parameters.description: Sort key: 'listed_over_predicted' (default, ascending — most underpriced first), 'listed_price_per_acre_ksh', 'predicted_price_per_acre_ksh', 'size_acres'.

get.description: Log-scale price histogram + percentiles over the usable listings.

distance_km.title: Distance Km
distance_km.description: Haversine distance from the predicted point

ComparableListingResponse.title: ComparableListingResponse
ComparableListingResponse.description:
One nearby listing returned as a comparable.

Note: ``list_date`` / ``days_ago`` is intentionally OMITTED — Notebook
1's ``list_date`` is empty for every listing, so fabricating a value
would mislead the user.  See the comparables.py docstring.

dist_to_nairobi_km.title: Dist To Nairobi Km
dist_to_nairobi_km.description: Haversine distance to Nairobi CBD (recomputed from lat/lon via B1's haversine_km_vectorised — Cell 4.2's formula, same earth radius 6371.0 km).  Null when the listing's coordinates are missing.

CountyListingScatterRow.title: CountyListingScatterRow
CountyListingScatterRow.description:
One row of GET /api/v1/counties/{county}/listings — the scatter-plot fields.

``listed_price_per_acre_ksh`` and ``size_acres`` come directly from
``listings_scored.parquet`` (Cell 9.6).  ``dist_to_nairobi_km`` is
recomputed from the stored lat/lon via B1's haversine — the raw column
didn't survive into the export (Cell 9.6 only carries ID_COLUMNS +
price columns, not feature columns).

CountyRowCount.title: CountyRowCount
CountyRowCount.description: One row of GET /api/v1/counties/row_counts — county name + listing count.

median_price_per_acre_ksh.title: Median Price Per Acre Ksh
median_price_per_acre_ksh.description: Median KSh per acre for the county

mean_log_price_per_acre.title: Mean Log Price Per Acre
mean_log_price_per_acre.description: Mean of the log target (log KSh per acre)

water_body_distance_share.title: Water Body Distance Share
water_body_distance_share.description: Share of listings with a measured water-body distance

n_below_min_county_n.title: N Below Min County N
n_below_min_county_n.description: True when n_listings < CONFIG.MIN_COUNTY_N (Cell 9.5). The county's summary statistics rest on too few listings to trust.

CountySummaryRow.title: CountySummaryRow
CountySummaryRow.description:
One row of ``county_summary.csv`` — Cell 9.5 builds it as a
per-county groupby over ``df_model``.

DriverContributionResponse.title: DriverContributionResponse
DriverContributionResponse.description:
One feature's contribution to the prediction.

The SHAP value is on the log scale (log KSh per acre).  The effect %
follows explain_spec.md's rule (Cell 9.10):

    effect(f) = exp(s_f) - 1   (multiplicative change in typical price
                                per acre attributable to feature f)

tree_share_explained_by_shap.title: Tree Share Explained By Shap
tree_share_explained_by_shap.description: Sum of tree-member (xgb + catboost) weights in the loaded ensemble

tabnet_share_not_covered.title: Tabnet Share Not Covered
tabnet_share_not_covered.description: TabNet's weight in the loaded ensemble (0 if pruned). The TabNet share of the blend is NOT covered by SHAP.

explained_members.title: Explained Members
explained_members.description: Which members the SHAP values cover (xgb, catboost)

unexplained_members.title: Unexplained Members
unexplained_members.description: Which members are NOT covered (tabnet, if loaded)

combined_base_value.title: Combined Base Value
combined_base_value.description: Combined base value on the log scale (weighted sum of member base values)

typical_price_per_acre_ksh.title: Typical Price Per Acre Ksh
typical_price_per_acre_ksh.description: exp(combined_base_value) — the typical KSh per acre before per-feature adjustments

latency_ms.title: Latency Ms
latency_ms.description: Wall-clock latency of this request's live SHAP computation. TreeExplainer is built once (cached for the process); shap_values on a single row is typically sub-millisecond to a few ms.

EnsembleShapCoverage.title: EnsembleShapCoverage
EnsembleShapCoverage.description:
Recomputed from whichever members actually got loaded (post-pruning),
NOT the notebook's static manifest values.

n_listings.title: N Listings
n_listings.description: Count of listings in that band

oof_rmse.title: Oof Rmse
oof_rmse.description: OOF RMSE for that band (log scale)

oof_mae.title: Oof Mae
oof_mae.description: OOF MAE for that band (log scale)

ensemble_shap_coverage.title: Ensemble Shap Coverage
ensemble_shap_coverage.description: From the manifest — the weighted sum of member SHAP values explains the tree share; the TabNet share is NOT covered. Reports ``tree_share_explained_by_shap`` and ``tabnet_share_not_covered`` plus the notebook's note.

ExplainabilityResponse.title: ExplainabilityResponse
ExplainabilityResponse.description:
GET /api/v1/model/explainability — combines shap_global,
feature_importance and feature_labels in one payload so the tab can
render the global-importance chart and the plain-English feature
labels in a single round-trip.

missing_%.title: Missing %
missing_%.description: Share of dev-set rows with the feature missing (%)

mutual_info.title: Mutual Info
mutual_info.description: Mutual information vs the target; NaN when not computed.

perm_delta_rmse.title: Perm Delta Rmse
perm_delta_rmse.description: Permutation importance — RMSE increase when the feature is shuffled within the dev fold (Cell 3.6).

mean_abs_shap.title: Mean Abs Shap
mean_abs_shap.description: Mean |SHAP| on the dev set; NaN for non-tree-screened features.

selection_votes.title: Selection Votes
selection_votes.description: Votes across the Phase 3 selection methods

FeatureEvaluationRow.title: FeatureEvaluationRow
FeatureEvaluationRow.description:
One row of ``feature_evaluation.csv`` — Cell 3.8's ``ranked_table``,
written out by Cell 9.3.  Every value is on the development set.

method.title: Method
method.description: xgb = gain; catboost = PredictionValuesChange (or 'mean_abs_shap (fallback; ...)' when the native importance is unavailable on a loaded model); tabnet = permutation on the development set (5 shuffles, seed from manifest.config.SEED).

FeatureImportanceRow.title: FeatureImportanceRow
FeatureImportanceRow.description:
One row of ``feature_importance.csv`` — Cell 9.4 builds one row per
(model, feature) pair for all three models, with ``method`` recording
how the importance was computed.

artifacts_loaded.title: Artifacts Loaded
artifacts_loaded.description: True when all expected artifact files are present

listed_over_predicted.title: Listed Over Predicted
listed_over_predicted.description: Listed / predicted ratio (>1 = listed above model)

data_quality_flag.title: Data Quality Flag
data_quality_flag.description: True when the listing's log price per acre falls outside the development target's 1st-99th percentile window (Cell 9.6).

ListingsScoredRow.title: ListingsScoredRow
ListingsScoredRow.description:
One row of ``listings_scored.parquet`` — Cell 9.6.

The identifier columns (Cell 9.2's ``ID_COLUMNS``) plus the size,
the listed / predicted / low / high per-acre prices, the
listed-over-predicted ratio, the scored-by tag (oof / test), the
verdict (underpriced / overpriced / fair) and a data-quality flag.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.description: Top N drivers sorted by |shap_value| descending

LiveExplanationResponse.title: LiveExplanationResponse
LiveExplanationResponse.description: The driver breakdown + recomputed shares for one prediction.

MetricsJsonResponse.title: MetricsJsonResponse
MetricsJsonResponse.description:
The ``metrics.json`` half of GET /api/v1/model/metrics — returned
verbatim (the file's structure is nested and stable, so exposing it
as a free-form dict keeps the endpoint faithful to the notebook).

MetricsResponse.title: MetricsResponse
MetricsResponse.description: Full GET /api/v1/model/metrics response — table + JSON together.

MetricsTableResponse.title: MetricsTableResponse
MetricsTableResponse.description: Response for the table half of GET /api/v1/model/metrics.

county_group_cv_rmse.title: County Group Cv Rmse
county_group_cv_rmse.description: County-grouped CV RMSE; NaN for models without one.

ensemble_weight.title: Ensemble Weight
ensemble_weight.description: Member's ensemble weight; NaN when the model is not in MODEL_ORDER.

MetricsTableRow.title: MetricsTableRow
MetricsTableRow.description:
One row of ``metrics_table.csv`` — Cell 9.3 writes one row per
(run, model) pair.  The production run's ``weighted_ensemble`` row
also carries the trimmed-test result and interval_coverage_* fields,
which are optional here because every other row leaves them blank.

oof.title: Oof
oof.description: Development-set out-of-fold predictions (each row predicted by models that never trained on it)

test.title: Test
test.description: Test-set predictions (models fitted on development data only)

oof_count.title: Oof Count
oof_count.description: Total OOF rows in the file (may differ from len(oof) when sampling)

test_count.title: Test Count
test_count.description: Total test rows in the file (may differ from len(test) when sampling)

sampled.title: Sampled
sampled.description: True when a sample parameter was used — the returned rows are a deterministic subset

sample_size.title: Sample Size
sample_size.description: The sample size requested (null when no sampling)

ModelPredictionsResponse.title: ModelPredictionsResponse
ModelPredictionsResponse.description: GET /api/v1/model/predictions response — both OOF + test sets together.

category.title: Category
category.description: hospital / school / market / bank / police / bus_stop / fuel / other

is_fallback.title: Is Fallback
is_fallback.description: True when the name is a generated fallback label ('<category> near <town>') rather than a real OSM name.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: The filters actually applied (echoed for the client).

PaginationMeta.title: PaginationMeta
PaginationMeta.description: Standard pagination block returned by every list endpoint.

place_type.title: Place Type
place_type.description: OSM place tag value (city, town, suburb, ...)

county.title: County
county.description: County (filled by the backend via point-in-polygon; may be null)

is_fallback.title: Is Fallback
is_fallback.description: True when the name is a generated fallback label ('<category> near <town>') rather than a real OSM name.

PredictNamedPOI.title: PredictNamedPOI
PredictNamedPOI.description:
A named POI near the predicted point — for the 'Nearby & Infrastructure' list.

Sourced from kenya_pois_named.gpkg (Cell 5.2's ogr2ogr with `name` added
to the -select list).  POIs without a name in OSM fall back to
'<category> near <nearest town>' — these are labels, not real names.
The ``is_fallback`` flag is True for those fallback labels so the frontend
can style them distinctly (lighter text / "approximate" tag).

parcel_features.title: Parcel Features
parcel_features.description: Infrastructure checklist. Keys are the ten item names (borehole, piped_water, river_water, water_tank, grid_electric, solar_electric, full_fence, partial_fence, structures, internal_road). Values are true / false / 'not_sure' (or null).

confidence_level.title: Confidence Level
confidence_level.description: Confidence level for the multiplicative conformal interval. 0.50 / 0.80 / 0.90 are pre-calibrated; any value in (0, 1) is accepted (q recomputed from OOF residuals).

ensemble_members.title: Ensemble Members
ensemble_members.description: Which members were actually loaded (post-pruning) and their renormalised weights.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: B1's diagnostics: nearest places, infra source, spatial-index load state.

explanation.description: Live driver breakdown (Cell 9.4 SHAP + Cell 9.10 money-effect rule). Null when no tree models are loaded or the explanation service is unavailable.

comparables.title: Comparables
comparables.description: Nearby listings from listings_scored.parquet within 50 km, ranked by distance.  Empty when listings_scored.parquet is not loaded.

named_pois.title: Named Pois
named_pois.description: Named POIs within 5 km of the predicted point (hospital, school, market, etc.) from kenya_pois_named.gpkg.  Empty when the named-POI layer is not loaded.

PredictResponse.title: PredictResponse
PredictResponse.description:
POST /api/v1/predict response — Cell 8.3 + Cell 9.1 + total + warning
+ live driver breakdown + comparables + named POIs.

pred_simple_average.title: Pred Simple Average
pred_simple_average.description: Simple average of member predictions (log scale)

fold.title: Fold
fold.description: Held-out fold of first CV repeat (-1 for test rows)

PredictionRow.title: PredictionRow
PredictionRow.description: One row from oof_predictions or test_predictions parquet.

PriceBin.title: PriceBin
PriceBin.description:
One histogram bin on the log10 price axis.

``lower_ksh`` / ``upper_ksh`` are the bin edges in KSh per acre
(inclusive-exclusive, except the final bin which includes its upper
edge).  ``count`` is the number of usable listings in the bin.

n_usable.title: N Usable
n_usable.description: Usable listings (rows in listings_scored with a finite per-acre price)

n_flagged.title: N Flagged
n_flagged.description: Listings flagged by data_quality_flag (excluded from training)

PriceDistributionResponse.title: PriceDistributionResponse
PriceDistributionResponse.description:
GET /api/v1/data/price-distribution response.

``n_usable`` powers the Modeling Yield tile; ``n_flagged`` (rows whose
``data_quality_flag`` is true) powers the Sanitization tile.  The raw
pre-cleaning "observed corpus" count is NOT here — that number does not
exist anywhere the backend loads; the frontend marks that tile
unavailable.

PricePercentiles.title: PricePercentiles
PricePercentiles.description:
Percentile set of the usable per-acre asking prices (KSh).

Web shows p1 / p50 / p99; mobile m12 shows p10 / p50 / p90 — both come
from this single block so the two breakpoints never disagree.

ShapGlobalRow.title: ShapGlobalRow
ShapGlobalRow.description:
One row of ``shap_global.csv`` — Cell 9.4 builds one row per
(model, feature) pair for the two tree models (xgb, catboost).
